text:
alex: Heads-up — staging docs build is failing after the redirect migration. Error mentions broken redirects + some Markdown link noise.

maria: ugh. saw that in CI logs this morning. can you paste the error?

alex: sure, here's the top bit from the build log: 
```
Error: Broken link: /docs/getting-started#deploy -> cannot find target (resolved to /docs/getting-started.md#deploy)
Hint: check permalink/slug or redirects config
```

jon: this smells like the plugin-client-redirects config lost some from->to rules when we moved pages. We also changed permalink style to remove trailing slashes which changes anchor resolution.

maria: i reproduced locally with `yarn docusaurus start` and got the same. quick workaround: convert relative anchor links to absolute doc permalinks, e.g. use `/docs/getting-started#deploy` instead of `./getting-started.md#deploy` in cross-doc links.

sam: would it help to add explicit redirects for renamed paths? plugin config: 
```js
// docusaurus.config.js
plugins: [
  [
    '@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects',
    {
      redirects: [
        {from: '/getting-started', to: '/docs/getting-started'},
        {from: '/old-guide#how-to', to: '/docs/guide#how-to'}
      ]
    }
  ]
]
```

alex: yes but there are a couple of anchors that changed shape after the mkdocs -> docusaurus migration (headers with emojis and special chars got normalized differently). e.g. `## What's new?` -> anchor becomes `whats-new` vs `what-s-new` depending on parser.

maria: we should normalize headings to simple ascii in docs that are linked from other pages. step 1: fix the few problematic headings. step 2: add redirect rules for any removed paths. step 3: add a test in CI that runs link-checker after build.

jon: for step 1, quick sed patch works. example: replace `## What's new?` with `## What's new` (drop punctuation) or reword to `## Release notes`.

alex: i'm pushing a small PR with two fixes: 1) replace relative md links in `getting-started` and `guide` with docusaurus permalinks, 2) add three redirects to docusaurus.config.js. will drop the PR link here when ready.

docs-bot: build-status: broken — docs/staging — 1748123470

sam: thanks. also add a note in the migration checklist about anchor normalization and the `plugin-client-redirects` requirements so this doesn't bite other pages later.

alex: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428 — includes changelog entry and CI link-check job (script: `node scripts/link-check.js`).

maria: reviewed, left one comment about using `permalink` frontmatter instead of hardcoding absolute links in case we want to move files later.

jon: took a quick look — lgtm after maria's comment is addressed. small nit: include `--max-old-space-size=4096` in the CI docusaurus build step or it OOMs on large site.

alex: updated permaf. changed the two absolute links to frontmatter `permalink` references and added the CI memory flag. re-running local build.

alex: local build ✅, link-checker passes: `0 broken links`.

maria: deploying the staging build now. if staging is green we can merge and backfill redirects to prod.

docs-bot: deploy: staging succeeded — 1748123850 :rocket: 

sam: awesome. for follow-up can someone add a section in docs/dev-migration.md about the anchor differences and a small script that prints a table of old->new anchors for manual verification?

alex: adding that as a follow-up issue and tagging @eng-ml to be aware of any notebooks that may link into docs. issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/129

jon: nice. thanks all. closing this thread once PR merges. :+1:

alex: merging now. will watch prod link-checker tomorrow morning.

maria: thanks everyone :)
